description: Pinned, openly licensed monotonic Modern Greek text for the monotonic Modern Greek next-word model and the corpus routes of the monotonic word list. Read by build/el_corpus.py and extract_el_monotonic_lm.py. Every readable source carries a license on ALLOWED_LICENSES in build/el_corpus.py; NonCommercial and NoDerivatives sources are refused, and the sources kept out are listed under excluded with the reason. Licenses were checked on the source pages on 2026-11-06.

split.note: The split hashes each document's group (a sitting, a consultation, an article, an entry), so repeated text in one group stays on one side. Training sentences whose case-folded token sequence equals a dev sentence of any source are removed.

dedup_note: The dev-duplicate rule and the repeat cap apply to sentences of at least dedup_min_tokens tokens. Shorter sentences (Ευχαριστώ, Το ξέρω, Τι να κάνουμε, Γεια σου) recur naturally in every source; removing their repeats would remove the most conversational sentences from training.

sources.title: OpenCouncil municipal council transcripts
sources.disabled_reason: No named open license: the OpenCouncil terms (https://opencouncil.gr/terms, section 7) allow free use and redistribution of the transcripts but name no license and do not address commercial use. Needs the owner's review and written confirmation from OpenCouncil. The Hugging Face repository is also gated and access has not been granted to this account.
sources.license_evidence: Hugging Face dataset card glossAPI/OpenCouncil: license other, 'Redistribution permitted according to OpenCouncil Terms of Use'.
sources.register: spoken municipal council meetings (speech recognition plus human checking)

reader.note: Reader not written: the file could not be read (gated). The sha256 is a placeholder until access is granted.

excluded.reason: NonCommercial and NoDerivatives (dataset card). The best conversational candidate (theatre dialogue); usable only with a commercial license from the National Theatre archive.
NonCommercial and NoDerivatives (dataset card body; front matter says other).
